summary: Core Window.RequestAutoscroll/TakeAutoscroll and List's autoscroll path (requests taken per item during prepaint, scroll computed with the pinned above/below walks, first pass discarded through a transact rollback and prepainted again); TextView reveal calls it, so a line inside a long block scrolls into view. The inline text row walk replaces per-character position queries. Also ports the uncovered text_view.rs linked-image click test.

files: gpui/window.go: pending autoscroll fields (frame-stamped, the port's equivalent of clearing at draw start), RequestAutoscroll, TakeAutoscroll, internal transact rolling back hitboxes, deferred draws, dispatch tree, tab stops and mouse listeners
gpui/listelement.go: Prepaint follows prepaint_items' autoscroll; header no longer lists the path as omitted (uniform_list has no autoscroll in the pin)

base/text_inline.go: inlineTextRows row walk (doubling + binary search per row end), inlineTextLineBounds/inlineRowsExtent/glyphBoxes over rows; inlineText lays out fresh each frame (bug fix, see deviations)

tests.reveal_tests: 11 left by ticket 30: 10 ported as real-window tests (fail, never skip); 1 deviated (a_reveal_that_cannot_be_shown_gives_up counts laid-out-but-hidden frames up to the attempt limit 8, with 400 words instead of 4000, because the real frame loop keeps drawing while a reveal is pending)
tests.coverage_gap_closed: text_view.rs:2227 linked_image_handler_receives_left_middle_and_right_clicks (clicks recorded through the handler; TestApp has no opened_url)
tests.paint_timing: test text system 400 words: 1.93s -> 0.06-0.25s, 2.75s -> 0.06s, 1.03s -> 0.03s; real window inlineTextLineBounds 2.3ms -> 1.1ms, glyphBoxes 3.5ms -> 3.8ms

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD bc44de1 + the ticket-37 working tree (no other workers running)
orchestrator_rerun.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./gpui ./base && gofmt -l gpui base && go build ./...

tests.environmental: TestWin32InputRealWindowWheelScrolls failed in about a third of the worker's full gpui runs; instrumented: GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SHIFT)=0x8000, so Shift was held system-wide by interactive use of the machine (nothing in gpui injects Shift); green in 5 consecutive quiet runs and in the orchestrator's run. Same class as the documented cursor gate.

deviations: the autoscroll request is frame-stamped and ignored outside its frame, instead of being cleared at the start of each draw
transact does not roll back accessed element states or the line-layout index (harmless; see the window.go comment)

inlineText lays the text out fresh every frame: gpui's TextLayout reuses a cached size without touching the window line cache, so a retained layout pointed at a freed native line ('text shaping handle is stale'); the cache returns the same shaped line, so nothing is reshaped
follow_ups: gpui/win32input_windows_test.go:535: guard the per-line check with !event.Modifiers.Shift (it divides by a zero vertical delta when Shift is held)
gpui/styled_text.go cached-size branch: mark the line used in the window line cache, so retained layouts can be reused as upstream
performance: paintRowGlyphs fetches all of a long line's glyphs per row (~33% of a 4000-word paint)
